items.source: Exclude one or more fields from being returned by the query operation.
items.translation: 从查询操作中排除一个或多个fields的返回。

items.source: Include one or more fields to be returned by the query operation.
items.translation: 包含一个或多个 `fields` 以指定查询操作应返回的字段。

items.source: Project a given MongoExpression to a field included in the result.
items.translation: 将给定的MongoExpression投影为包含在结果中的field。

items.source: Project a $slice of the array field using the first size elements starting at offset.
items.translation: 使用从 offset 开始的第一个 size 个元素，对数组 field 进行 $slice 投影。

items.source: Project a $slice of the array field using the first size elements.
items.translation: 使用数组 field 的前 size 个元素来投影其 $slice。

items.source: Set the name to be used in the result and return a Field.
items.translation: 将结果中使用的名称设置为一个Field。

items.source: Exclude a single field from being returned by the query operation.
items.translation: 从查询操作中排除单个 `field` 的返回。

items.source: Exclude one or more properties from being returned by the query operation.
items.translation: 从查询操作中排除一个或多个properties的返回。

items.source: Include a single field to be returned by the query operation.
items.translation: 在查询操作中返回单个 `field`。

items.source: Include one or more properties to be returned by the query operation.
items.translation: 包含一个或多个properties，以便查询操作返回这些属性。

items.source: MongoDB specific query and update support.
items.translation: 支持针对 MongoDB 的特定查询和更新操作。

items.source: The array field must appear in the query.
items.translation: 查询中必须包含数组字段。

items.source: Uses of Field in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query
items.translation: Field 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query 包中的用途
